name: SoFiUSD
oneLiner: SoFiUSD is SoFi Bank's USD stablecoin, fully reserved by cash at the bank's Federal Reserve master account; minted and redeemed 1:1 via BitGo infrastructure.
collateral: 1:1 USD reserves held as cash or cash equivalents at SoFi Bank's Federal Reserve master account; reserves earn interest on reserve balances (IORB) retained by SoFi, not passed to holders
pegMechanism: 1:1 mint and redeem via BitGo infrastructure; instant conversions between dollars and SOFID

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for SOFID as of 2026-06-18. GENIUS Act is law (enacted July 2025) but implementing regulations remain in proposed-rules phase; no PPSI applications have been accepted yet. SoFi Bank N.A. is an OCC-supervised IDI and under GENIUS would issue via a subsidiary; no such subsidiary PPSI application was found.

mintAuthority.summary: SOFID is issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. (OCC-chartered) with BitGo Bank & Trust providing Stablecoin-as-a-Service. The on-chain contract (Ethereum ERC1967 UUPS proxy) has three EOA controls operated by BitGo: DEFAULT_ADMIN, MASTER_MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADER_ROLE. All confirmed as EOAs (no bytecode).

controls.label: BitGo issuance backend (Stablecoin-as-a-Service for SoFi)
controls.evidence: BitGo Bank & Trust operates mint, burn, custody, and smart-contract management for SOFID on behalf of issuer SoFi Bank; supply is created 1:1 against cash at SoFi's Federal Reserve master account. No permissionless mint route.

sources.label: BitGo selected by SoFi to provide stablecoin infrastructure

controls.label: SOFID DEFAULT_ADMIN (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295030, owner() returned 0xd84519fc7137e55d37674be353379a27a9bd21fe; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). Confirmed has DEFAULT_ADMIN role via hasRole(). Contract is AccessControlDefaultAdminRules; owner() returns the DEFAULT_ADMIN.

controls.label: SOFID MASTER_MINTER_ROLE (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295030, RoleGranted event and hasRole(MASTER_MINTER_ROLE, 0x06720dec...) returned true; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). MASTER_MINTER_ROLE = 0x4d722a319ebda03eb1179096607e87f360b089b3919a0d764a65ea950521a6c9.

controls.label: SOFID UPGRADER_ROLE (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295030, RoleGranted event and hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0x564fd...) returned true; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). UPGRADER_ROLE = 0xcf6f9f892731e14b8859835f2ff35575f447fb501f46243c4eb8bac19e31a050. Can upgrade the UUPS proxy implementation.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295030: proxy 0x0CB6d03B...678092E (ERC1967 UUPS) has impl 'Stablecoin' at 0x69edf9fa820df057e493635ed1db6b9e5f8124a0. owner()/DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0xd84519fc... (no bytecode confirmed). MASTER_MINTER_ROLE = EOA 0x06720dec... (no bytecode confirmed, hasRole true). UPGRADER_ROLE = EOA 0x564fd... (no bytecode confirmed, hasRole true). No proxy admin (EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0). All three EOAs confirmed as BitGo-operated; on-chain mint surface fully addressed.

featuredContent.title: SoFi unveils first bank-issued stablecoin for enterprise payments
featuredContent.description: SoFi Bank becomes the first nationally chartered U.S. bank to issue a stablecoin on a public blockchain, targeting enterprise settlement.

milestones.title: SoFiUSD launches as first nationally chartered U.S. bank stablecoin
milestones.description: SoFi Bank, N.A. issues SOFID on Ethereum; 1:1 backed by cash at Federal Reserve master account; initially for enterprise settlement, not consumer-facing.

milestones.title: Mastercard partnership for SoFiUSD settlement across global payments network
milestones.description: Card issuers and acquirers can settle transactions using SoFiUSD 24/7 via Mastercard's Multi-Token Network (MTN) across 200+ countries.
